en: A vintage black-and-white illustration showing a fortified castle or town under siege, with smoke clouds from cannon fire and curved trajectories of cannonballs overhead. The main building appears to have a church-like structure and watchtowers, all behind strong walls set on a raised mound. The words 'Düna' and 'Fluvius' are labeled on the rivers, and the caption below reads 'Die Belagerung von Kokenhusen i. J. 1700.'
